title: Playful Retro Robot Agency Landing Page

analysis.title: Playful Retro Robot Agency Landing Page
analysis.notes: A vivid one-page agency layout pairs oversized white lettering with detailed cartoon robots, flat color fields, and thick dark outlines. The yellow content section uses a centered process heading, three rounded cards, and small character illustrations to create a friendly, highly illustrated rhythm.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a bright editorial landing-page hero illustration for a playful design studio: a large friendly retro-futurist robot standing on the right, assembled from chunky pink, orange, teal, and cream panels with visible bolts, screens, antennae, and thick black comic outlines. Leave generous open space on the left for oversized white headline typography. Use a vivid bubblegum-pink background, flat vector colors, subtle grain, whimsical proportions, and crisp screen-print-like shading. No logos, brand names, or readable text.
